scope: Nominal UTC-duration and timezone arithmetic only. Frozen actual FateBridge sky operands isolate the clock conversion and do not receive independent celestial/source/predictive acceptance. Unused physical runtime metadata is excluded; full operands and HTTP records remain in the external phase archive.
selection: 48 already exposed development cases;8 explicit zones,3time keys,2directions,Tropic/static-axis method. Not an independent validation cohort or new sample denominator.

clock_acceptance.birth_instant: Exact epoch-microsecond equality for each independently resolved explicit input
clock_acceptance.event_instant: Returned second-only event label must lie no more than1.00001seconds before and no more than0.00001seconds after the independently computed event instant. The10microsecond allowance is fixed for existing float-duration representation; it is not a physical accuracy line.
clock_acceptance.local_fields_and_offset: Returned local fields and UTC offset equal the reference label for the same displayed event instant; no nonexistent/fabricated local label or stale offset
clock_acceptance.raw_model_preservation: Except the event_datetime label, retain event identities, ages, arcs, coordinate data, windows, sources and existing display limits exactly. Reference inputs and gates unchanged after fixes.
clock_acceptance.zero_offset_controls: UTC and fixed+08:00 verify unchanged label behavior. Historic/daylight controls expose one-hour,half-hour,quarter-hour,seconds-offset and date-line changes.

year_definition: Existing365.2425 nominal86400-second days per model year; exact reference coefficient146097/400, not a measured tropical year
offset_export: Numeric Temporal.ZonedDateTime.offsetNanoseconds/1e9 from portable-temporal-offsets.json.gz. Human toString offset text is rounded to minutes; the first six portable failures and their original data remain in the external archive.
